title: Illuminate connections / comment interaction

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Use a brief visual change to make a small social interaction noticeable.
strategic_value: A gradient response can connect Instagram’s brand colors with a recognizable product action.
demonstration: A comment begins in black with an outline heart, gains a gradient emphasis and filled heart with one like, then returns to plain text while retaining the liked state.
practical_value: Separate temporary emphasis from the persistent state that tells the person an action occurred.

content_islands.name: Comment block
content_islands.spec: Center the avatar, account name and two-line comment on white.

content_islands.name: Interaction state
content_islands.spec: Animate the text emphasis and heart while retaining the small time, like and reply row.

reference_purposes.Expression: The comment briefly takes on a brand-gradient treatment.
reference_purposes.Application: The sequence applies the visual emphasis to a specific like interaction.

ingredient.name: Temporary gradient emphasis
ingredient.role: Draw attention to a connection while preserving the underlying comment.
ingredient.application: Use the short emphasis separately from the persistent filled-heart and like-count state shown.
ingredient.scope: This illustrative animation; no production timing, easing or universal UI requirement is specified.
